topic.title: COCONUT natural products with Morgan + MACCS fingerprints (no pickle)
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
I’ve shared 436k COCONUT 2.0 natural products, sorted by mass, with precomputed Morgan-2048 + MACCS fingerprints in plain Parquet/NumPy, so there’s no pickle to load and no RDKit needed to use them. The description has a 10 ppm window example and code to add the training structures yourself (they can’t be redistributed).

Dataset: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aryanawasthiteykik/casmi26-coconut-morgan-maccs-fingerprints It matches the outputs of my spectrum→fingerprint model: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aryanawasthiteykik/casmi26-spectrum-to-fingerprint-mlp

Credit to @prvsiyan 's COCONUT candidates dataset and to the COCONUT team. Feedback welcome.
